authorization.scope: Repeat the bounded A0.4 to A0.5 DEVELOPMENT evaluator and Method Ψ execution after correcting source binding, sandbox capability verification, and partial evidence retention.

calibration.clean_source_control_rule: Add one warmup and ten measured calls per evaluator only if any frozen evaluator-runner field differs from V1; never pool V1 and V2 samples.

transition_runs.psi: Existing A0.5 DEVELOPMENT implementation, run in a digest-pinned network-disabled container after successful capability preflight.

post_execution_readback_retry.retry_reason: Persisted development_run.json contains evaluator_observations omitted by the compact wrapper return; analysis must read the sealed partial-archive manifest and candidate-validation evidence.
post_execution_readback_retry.retry_policy: Rerun the complete frozen V2 calibration and transition plan after the readback implementation changes; preserve the prior release and do not pool its timings or transition attempts with the retry.

timing.scope_verification_boundary: Outer interval around source-bound evaluator and complete-scope readback
timing.method_process_boundary: Isolated Docker process start to process exit
timing.full_transition_boundary: Outer interval around run_a05_transition and archive attempt
timing.cpu: Host self and child CPU deltas; child CPU includes evaluator/Git/verifier children
